data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 16.0 million, (2014: GBP 18.6 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

prior_year_events.event_name: RITC take on reserves (incoming RITC and quota share portfolios)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsurance-to-close (RITC) take-on added reserves to the syndicate's book (RITC take on reserves shown in technical provisions), distorting comparatives and increasing outstanding claims for older underwriting years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was GBP 308.138m. During 2015 there was a gross decrease in prior year provisions of GBP 8.228m (a release of c.2.7% of opening reserves). The report attributes favourable prior-year movement largely to benign claims development and the effect of reinsurance arrangements (including RITC/quota share activity). The RITC take-on of other syndicates materially affected the reserves profile and has distorted comparatives for older underwriting years.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 16.0 million, (2014: GBP 18.6 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
The overall movement in net claims provisions is stated after taking into account the impact of incoming RITC and quota share portfolios.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) comparative column (2014). Prior year movement (gross) taken from Technical Provisions table row 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross column). The report also quotes a net favourable movement (GBP 16.0m) in claims outstanding (net of reinsurance) in the claims note - that net figure differs from the gross movement used above. RITC take-on reserves (85.227m gross) materially affect comparatives and development tables. Some per-class reserve movements published in the claims note are net of reinsurance; lob_movements above use those net class figures (confidence lowered). The claims development table is present but partially aggregated and influenced by incoming RITC, reducing reliability for PYD triangulation.
